review_candidates.title: Design & Estimation Engineer (PEB)
review_candidates.company: AL Shahen Holding Group مجموعة الشاهين القابضة
review_candidates.description: We are looking for a Design & Estimation Engineer with solid experience in Pre-Engineered Buildings (PEB) to join our engineering team and support major projects in Saudi Arabia. Key Responsibilities * Prepare safe, economical, and optimized structural designs for PEB projects based on project specifications and applicable design codes. * Prepare Material Take-Off (MTO) and accurate cost estimations. * Design primary steel members and structural connections for PEB structures. * Prepare and review Proposal Drawings and ensure compliance with project requirements. * Convert design outputs into estimation sheets and design sketches for production. * Design steel connections using MBS for standard projects and IDEA StatiCa for complex projects. * Review approval drawings before releasing them to the Project Management and Production teams. * Coordinate with drafting and engineering teams to ensure high-quality project delivery. Requirements * Bachelor's Degree in Civil or Structural Engineering. * 3–7 years of experience in PEB design and estimation. * Strong knowledge of the following design codes: ▪️ AISC 2010 ▪️ AISI 2003 ▪️ SBC 2018 / 2024 ▪️ ASCE 7 (2010 / 2016) ▪️ IBC 2012 / 2018 ▪️ MBMA 2012 / 2018 * Excellent command of: ▪️ STAAD.Pro / STAAD-Connect ▪️ AutoCAD ▪️ IDEA StatiCa * Experience with MBS (Metal Building Software) is highly preferred. * Knowledge of Revit is an added advantage. * Strong analytical, technical, and communication skills. * Previous experience with Saudi or GCC projects is a plus.
review_candidates.verification: Exact LinkedIn jobs-guest jobPosting endpoint returned a job detail page during this run
review_candidates.review_policy: Always pass exact-detail candidate to ChatGPT; closed status, weak keyword evidence, noisy title, or freshness conflict are annotations only
